content: Atta dat, A see noda wision. A see a door open oba dey een heaben. An A yeh dat boice wa soun same like a trumpet, de same boice wa A been yeh. E tell me say, “Come op yah, an A gwine show ya dem ting wa haffa happen atta dis.”
Jes den God Sperit come pon me. Dey een heaben A see one shrone, a big chair wa king kin seddown pon. An A see somebody da sit pon um.
A shim wa sit dey da shine jes like jaspa an carnelian. An a rainbow wa da shine jes like emerald been dey all roun de shrone.
Twenty-fo oda shrone been dey all roun de fus shrone. An A see twenty-fo elda da seddown pon dem shrone. Dey beena weah white cloes, an gole crown been pon dey head.

Lightnin beena flash fom weh de fus big shrone been dey. Tunda beena roll, an plenty loud nise beena come fom dey. Dey een front ob de shrone seben lamp dem beena bun bright. Dem seben lamp yah dey God seben sperit dem.

Fo dat shrone A see sompin wa look jes like a glass sea, cleah like crystal. All roun de shrone, een de front an back an side, fo ting wa got life beena stanop. Dey got eye all oba dey body, front an back.
De fus ting wa got life look jes like a lion. De secon one look jes like a ox. An de nex one got a face wa look jes like de face ob a man. De las one look jes like a eagle wa da fly.
All fo ob dem ting wa got life, dey got six wing, an dey been kiba all oba wid eye, eben onda dey wing. All day an all night dey da taak ta God. Dey ain neba stop fa tell God say,

content.text: “We Lawd God got powa mo den all.
E been dey fo de wol been mek,
e dey now, an e gwine come back.”

content: Dem fo ting yah wa got life dey da praise de one wa gwine lib faeba an eba, wa da seddown pon de shrone. Dey da gim hona an tell um tankya.

Wensoneba dey do dat, de twenty-fo elda dem faddown fo de one wa da seddown pon de shrone. Dey da woshup um op, e wa gwine lib faeba an eba. Dey tek de crown dem off dey head an cyas um fo de shrone. An dey tell dat one pon de shrone say,

content.text: “We Lawd an we God. Ya got de right fa hab we fa git down fo ya,
an praise ya an gii ya hona an show ya got powa,
cause ya de one wa mek all ting.
Ya mek um an gim life cause ya wahn fa do dat.”
